BackstoryDef.title: Tundra gatherer
BackstoryDef.description: From childhood they learned which roots, berries, and hardy plants remained edible beyond the Wall.

BackstoryDef.title: Camp smith's apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Metal was precious, so every broken blade, buckle, and cooking pot was repaired until nothing remained to mend.

BackstoryDef.title: Shelter builder's child
BackstoryDef.description: They helped raise huts, palisades, hide shelters, and crude defenses that could be abandoned whenever the clan moved.

BackstoryDef.title: Bone carver
BackstoryDef.description: They carved antler, bone, and wood into charms, tools, and crude depictions of animals and old tales.

BackstoryDef.title: Clan fosterling
BackstoryDef.description: Raised for several years among another clan, they learned how different Free Folk groups survived and settled disputes.

BackstoryDef.title: Chieftain's firstborn
BackstoryDef.description: There were no southern titles to inherit, but everyone still expected a leader's child to prove worthy of being followed.

BackstoryDef.title: Chieftain's second child
BackstoryDef.description: Free from expectations of leadership, they spent more time ranging, climbing, riding, and fighting.

BackstoryDef.title: Fatherless spear-child
BackstoryDef.description: No septon declared them a bastard, and few Free Folk cared; what mattered was whether they could contribute to the clan.

BackstoryDef.title: Frozen Forest hunter
BackstoryDef.description: They learned to stalk elk and deer through snow without becoming prey to wolves or worse.

BackstoryDef.title: Young raider
BackstoryDef.description: Raids across rival territory taught them to fight early and patch up whatever wounds did not kill them outright.

BackstoryDef.title: Tundra forager
BackstoryDef.description: They survive on roots, berries, mushrooms, meat, and anything else the cold land grudgingly provides.

BackstoryDef.title: Free Folk smith
BackstoryDef.description: Without southern trade networks, they became experts at repairing and reusing every scrap of usable metal.

BackstoryDef.title: Clan shelter builder
BackstoryDef.description: They can turn timber, stone, hide, and packed earth into a defensible camp surprisingly quickly.

BackstoryDef.title: Frozen Forest tracker
BackstoryDef.description: Few tracks escape their notice, whether they belong to prey, rival clans, crows, or something unnatural.

BackstoryDef.title: Bone artist
BackstoryDef.description: Their carvings preserve stories in a culture where few people carry books.

BackstoryDef.title: Clan healer
BackstoryDef.description: They learned medicine from experience, herbs, and the accumulated knowledge of generations surviving beyond the Wall.

BackstoryDef.title: Storykeeper
BackstoryDef.description: They remember migrations, battles, bloodlines, legends, and warnings that southern maesters would dismiss as superstition.

BackstoryDef.title: Spearwife or raider
BackstoryDef.description: Among the Free Folk, anyone capable of fighting may be expected to defend the clan.

BackstoryDef.title: Clan speaker
BackstoryDef.description: They settle disputes and persuade fiercely independent people to cooperate without the authority of laws or titles.

BackstoryDef.title: Free Folk trader
BackstoryDef.description: They move between clans exchanging hides, metal, food, information, and whatever else can be carried through the wild.
